section_text: Wording For A Donation Made In Someone’s Memory An obituary asks others to give; a donor’s card tells the family that a gift has already been made. Use the examples above for the request. For a card or personal note after donating, name the person you are remembering and the organization that received the gift. Simple donor note: “I have made a gift to [Organization Name] in remembrance of [Name]. I’m thinking of you and your family.” With a personal memory: “I’ll always remember [Name]’s kindness when [brief memory]. I have made a memorial gift to [Organization Name] to honor that kindness.” These are original examples to adapt after the donation is complete. St. Jude’s memorial-card guidance recommends making the message personal, identifying the cause, and proofreading the names. Check whether the charity will send its own notification so you know what the family will receive.
title: Memorial Donation Wording for an Obituary | Final Notes
